cosy-slide.title: 👋 Let's Get Started!
cosy-slide.p: Welcome to your first lesson with CosyLanguages!

cosy-blockquote.p: In this 30–50 minute onboarding session, we will:

ul.li: Get to know each other through a quick warm-up;
Identify your primary learning goals and target timeline;
Discover your interests and preferred learning style;
Enjoy a short practice task and diagnostic conversation;
Select the best course and learning plan for you.

cosy-teacher-notes.p: Hello! Can you hear and see me well? My name is [Teacher Name]. In this lesson, we will get to know each other, discuss your goals, try out our interactive platform, and build your personalized learning roadmap!

cosy-slide.title: 🤝 About You & Me
cosy-slide.cosy-instruction: Step 2: Choose an icebreaker activity to get to know each other

ol.li: Where are you from, and what do you do?
What is one thing you really enjoy doing in your free time?
Why did you decide to practice English today?

cosy-choice-option-content.p: Let's find three hobbies, favorite foods, or travel destinations that we both like!

cosy-teacher-notes.p: Stage aim: to build rapport and establish a comfortable speaking environment.

cosy-slide.title: 🎯 Your English Goals & Interests
cosy-slide.cosy-instruction: Step 3: Tell us about your goals and top interests
cosy-slide.h3: When do you want to reach your goal?

cosy-slide.title: 🧠 How Do You Learn Best?
cosy-slide.cosy-instruction: Step 4: Answer a few quick questions about your learning preferences
cosy-slide.h3: How would you like your teacher to correct your mistakes?

cosy-select-item.cosy-select-item-title: Correct me immediately as I speak
Correct me after I finish speaking
Discuss main mistakes at the end of the activity
Correct only mistakes that affect understanding

cosy-slide.h3: What helps you when a task feels challenging?

ol.li: More time to think before answering
A hint or guiding Concept Check Question (CCQ)
Keywords written down on the workspace

cosy-slide.title: 🗣️ Let's Just Talk!
cosy-slide.cosy-instruction: Step 5: Pick a prompt card and enjoy a short diagnostic conversation

cosy-choice-option-content.p: Describe a memorable trip you took. Where did you go, and what made it special?
What does a typical productive day look like for you?

ul.li: Grammar check: Present tenses, Narrative tenses, Infinitives/Gerunds, Relative clauses.
Vocabulary check: Collocations, phrasal verbs, topic-specific vocabulary, paraphrasing.

cosy-slide.title: 🎓 Choose Your Course
cosy-slide.cosy-instruction: Step 6: Based on your goals and diagnostic speaking, here is your recommended course map

cosy-blockquote.p: Recommended Main Course: General English B1 (Intermediate)
Supplementary Modules: Spoken English B1 + Vocabulary Trainer

cosy-slide.title: ✅ Lesson Results
cosy-slide.cosy-instruction: Step 7: Confirm your course plan and schedule
cosy-slide.p: Your Goal: Master Intermediate (B1) and progress towards Upper-Intermediate (B2).
Recommended Frequency: 3 lessons per week for steady progress in 4–6 months.

cosy-teacher-notes.p: Thank you for a great introductory lesson! You did wonderful today. I look forward to seeing you in our next class on [Day/Time]!
